title: IP forwarding for IPv4 must not be enabled on AIX unless the system is a router.
check_content:
From the command prompt, run the following command:

# no -o ipforwarding 
ipforwarding = 0

If the value returned is not "0", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Disable IPv4 forwarding on the system by running command:
# no -p -o ipforwarding=0
VulnDiscussion: IP forwarding permits the kernel to forward packets from one network interface to another. The ability to forward packets between two networks is only appropriate for systems acting as routers.
